rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Israeli Bank MCP is a TypeScript server that connects AI assistants to Israeli banking data through the Model Context Protocol. It leverages the israeli-bank-scrapers library to provide secure access to transactions from all major Israeli banks and credit card companies. The server offers three main functionalities: listing available banks with their required credentials, fetching account transactions with flexible date ranges, and handling two-factor authentication. This implementation is particularly useful for financial analysis, expense tracking, and automated financial management across multiple Israeli financial institutions.
